descriptions.Arthurpmarinho/Trabalho-final-Eletronica: 4-floor elevator on PIC16F1827 with SCAN scheduling, PWM motor control and Bluetooth UART telemetry
descriptions.Arthurpmarinho/FPGA_ENSEA: VHDL modules with testbenches: ALU, HDMI timing controller, counter, shift register. GHDL CI
descriptions.Arthurpmarinho/Interface_Industrial_Proj: Real-time vibration monitoring for electric motors over Modbus RTU, with FFT and ISO 10816 diagnostics
descriptions.Arthurpmarinho/f1-ers-battery-sim: Electro-thermal model of an F1 ERS battery in Simulink and an energy deployment strategy from real telemetry
descriptions.anauehara/FPGA_TP_2026.02: Magic Screen: Etch-A-Sketch style drawing toy on a DE10-Nano. Debounced quadrature encoders move a cursor, a dual-port RAM framebuffer stores the drawing, and it is streamed out over HDMI. ENSEA FPGA lab, with Ana Carolina
descriptions.Arthurpmarinho/Trabalho_final_OO_2026-1: Sales and loyalty program for a themed café, object-oriented design in Java. UnB 2026/1
descriptions.Arthurpmarinho/Embarcado_2025_02: Lab exercises on PIC microcontrollers in MPLAB X. UnB Embedded Electronics 2025/2
descriptions.Arthurpmarinho/ted_ped_2_2024_02: FPGA labs in Vivado: state machines, counters, 7-segment display, PicoBlaze. UnB 2024/2
descriptions.Arthurpmarinho/2026_1_PI1_Grupo02_Hilmer: Autonomous maze-solving robot. I led the electronics, designed the KiCad board schematics and wrote the motor and sensor firmware on ESP32. 1st place in the UnB internal competition
descriptions.Arthurpmarinho/capital-rocket-team-avion: Flight avionics boards for the Boscov hybrid rocket: valve control and parachute deployment (CRM) and GPS/IMU LoRa telemetry (GNM). 1st place in the hybrid category at LASC 2025
